scenario.title: Transformer buy with alternate-policy and schedule clarification
scenario.summary: The real solicitation specifies five 300 kVA transformers but leaves delivery and budget unpriced and contains conflicting whole-unit substitution language. The agent must obtain a controlled buyer clarification before sourcing and then correct a late otherwise-compliant offer.

realism.notes: The quantity and technical/standards requirements come from the real High Point solicitation. The USD 300,000 price ceiling and 210-day delivery ceiling are synthetic controlled clarification values because the public bid form leaves those fields bidder-provided.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic High Point Transformer Supplier A
suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic High Point Transformer Supplier B
suppliers.notes: Fails the required ANSI/DOE compliance package.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic High Point Transformer Supplier C
suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.

events.observation: Synthetic benchmark clarification: whole-unit equivalents are acceptable only if all cited ANSI/DOE requirements are met; maximum total price is USD 300,000 and maximum delivery is 210 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 285,000 for five units with 190-day delivery and full cited standards compliance.
Supplier B quotes USD 260,000 with 180-day delivery but does not satisfy the cited ANSI/DOE compliance package.
Supplier C quotes USD 270,000 for five compliant equivalent units but requires 220 days.
Supplier C revises to USD 275,000 with 205-day delivery, preserving full standards compliance.

hard_constraints.description: The missing schedule/budget and whole-unit alternate ambiguity must be clarified before RFQ.
Award must cover the real estimated quantity of five transformers.
Award must satisfy the cited transformer standards/compliance requirements.
Synthetic benchmark delivery ceiling is 210 days after clarification.
Synthetic benchmark total-price ceiling is USD 300,000 after clarification.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C's revision satisfies quantity, standards, synthetic delivery, and synthetic budget requirements at the lowest feasible price.
Supplier A is also feasible but costs more than Supplier C's compliant revision.

failure_conditions: Sending RFQs before resolving the documented gaps/alternate ambiguity.
Awarding Supplier B despite standards noncompliance.

economic_objective.description: Among feasible active package offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
